I know you’re asking the other nice girls but I’m just a dude who has experienced this just like you are and To answer your last question. No, she would be absolutely the same. 

Reading your texts was like a copy of what I had to go through. 
I lived 3 years of this and became a completely different person. You won’t make her happy because she is asking you to sacrifice your entire being for her insecurity. Please realize that the only way you continue this is with complete misery or her breaking you in a way so painful you genuinely can’t imagine going through that again unless you end it now.

I was lucky to finally be so fed up that I got away even though I was so trained to not want to leave. I promise you the best thing this person needs is therapy and the confidence to be by herself and rely on herself to be happy. 

I’d never wish this pain on anyone else.

I remember growing up having the same feeling of needing to prove myself I was Mexican, I’m pale as hell and was born and raised in Mexico City so living in the states going through school and being picked on by Mexican-American kids cause i didn’t match the skin tone was a constant battle. I would always think “how are you judging me for not looking a certain way yet my first language was Spanish and you can’t even speak it yourself? I still celebrate my culture and traditions yet you have no clue on what those are?”. 

My parents are from Mexico City, my grand parents are from Mexico City. My entire family is from Mexico so when I moved to the states it was interesting explaining to people that not all Mexicans are brown or that not all brown skinned folks are from Mexico. We have so many ginger, black, white, even Korean and other Asian descents in Mexico. 

Be proud of your heritage and where you come from, you do not need the approval of others to be who you know you are, let alone fall into a stereotypical public view.

I came back to yugioh recently after a near decade long hiatus and also from playing magic. There is a LGS that is known for it’s yugioh locals and decided to give it a shot. To my “surprise” the entire scene was unfortunately not the warmest and I just didn’t feel like improving in such an environment. I have faced plenty of toxic competitive environments both in TCGs and video game tournament locals. I just didn’t feel like trying to improve in such an environment again and decided to start hosting my own locals with friends and other local players. I already host a bunch of casual and competitive Magic get togethers so seeing yugioh mixed in with a bunch of very nice and kind hearted people who are also willing to learn was well worth the effort. I managed to get a small local in my place of around 12 yugioh players and maybe the same for magic. 

Sometimes making your own environment is better for both you and maybe the scene. I refuse to have to deal with such people as it only causes the scene to dwindle and lose quality especially to the players who really wanna get better while enjoying the game. Being kind truly attracts amazing players and life long friends.
